text:
No tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected on ASSET-B (2,843.1 ha) between 2021 and 2025. Hansen data covered the whole property.

One caveat: small patch loss of about 0.4 ha in 2021 was observed, but it falls below the 0.5 ha event threshold and wasn't counted. Changes at edges or narrower than the 30 m pixels may also be missed, so this doesn't prove there was no change at all.

Context: the JRC map shows no forest on the property in 2020. Hansen shows 23 ha of tree cover in 2000 and several loss events before the 2021 baseline (2008, 2015, 2017, 2020), which fall outside your question period.

This is not a regulatory or compliance finding, and it says nothing about periods outside 2021–2025.
